title: REQ · A guard fails while any tracked path contains node_modules
summary: Guard throws when tracked paths include node_modules and passes otherwise.
description: Context: need regression protection. Desired: assertNoTrackedNodeModules(paths) throws listing offenders when trackedNodeModulesPaths is non-empty.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mocked listing containing node_modules/phaser/x.js, when the guard runs, then it throws naming that path.
Given a listing without node_modules paths, when the guard runs, then it does not throw.
technical_constraints: Input is an injected path list
